name: MUIAnno
description: Understanding mobile user interfaces is important for building intelligent systems such as automation tools, accessibility solutions, and UI-aware agents. However, progress in this area is still limited by the lack of high-quality datasets that reflect real-world mobile applications and include reliable annotations. In this work, we introduce MUIAnno, a publicly available expert-annotated dataset for mobile UI understanding, collected from a diverse set of applications across multiple categories available on the iTunes platform.
